notes: Stretch 1: p.135 row 7 from āāa (after t'eft'ef, which is not read), rows 8-9; p.136 rows 1-9 to '... ànt em'. Line numerals: '35.' p.135 row 7 inside neràu (after M17, before Z7) -> neràu kept in 34, seχem 35; '36.' p.135 row 9 inside āu (after G43) -> āu 35, em āṭet se-χu-k 36; '37.' p.136 row 2 between Àmentet and śu; '38.' p.136 row 3 inside àmχi (before the two reeds) -> àmχi 37; '39.' p.136 row 4 inside Seχet - Àaru (after D21) -> 38; '40.' p.136 row 6 at row start before peri - k; '41.' p.136 row 7 inside àritu - nek -> 40; '42.' p.136 row 8 between āṭet and ṭekai - k; '43.' p.136 row 9 inside maa - nek -> 42; ànt em in 43. Overlines: only one in the stretch, p.136 row 6, starting at the right edge of '40.' and covering O1 D21 M17 M17 D54 of peri - k, ending before V31. No square brackets in any sign line of the stretch (brackets only in English '[his]', '[which are]'). No footnote marks, no '(?)', '(sic)' or dots in this stretch. The owl of 'em' is printed with ear-tufts throughout; the same bird in seχem coded G17. The upright straight-beaked bird used for w (ḥeru, χāāu, āu, śu, etc.) also stands in neràu where G14 is expected; coded G43 approx throughout.
